analysis: The PR change in ProviderLoop+ModelLoading.swift is small, at roughly lines 1151-1155 and 1219-1222 of head. After a Nemotron Super slot is retired, and after a normal unload, it calls selectedModelRecovery.makeAllDue(now: .now) so waiting selected models are re-checked at the next capacity tick. Only the head text up to line ~1042 was supplied, so the changed lines themselves are visible only in the patch excerpt, not as numbered source. I examined the supplied head text, which is the unchanged load path. It covers the weight-hash TOCTOU bracketing for reusable SSD cache (T-041), fail-closed handling when the hash is unavailable or changed, the add-on hold fences (T-059), load-gate serialization, and unwind ordering. None of this is modified by the PR. The new calls only schedule earlier re-evaluation of selected-model recovery. They do not alter attestation, encryption, authorization, cache keying or the weight-hash publication path. Residual question: selectedModelRecovery.makeAllDue is defined elsewhere and was not supplied. It should be confirmed that the recovery loads it triggers still go through ensureModelLoaded and keep all admission, add-on hold, autopilot ownership and retirement checks (T-059, T-029). If instead it bypassed them, immediate retry after every unload could increase load churn or defeat the add-on hold. Nothing supplied shows that. No concrete regression identified.
